title: A layer row let go where it cannot land is still in the panels hand
goal: Pick a layer row up in the layers list and let it go somewhere it cannot land, over the picture or outside the window or by pressing escape. The list still thinks you are holding that row. Nothing visible goes wrong until the next drag, when the panel can draw a reorder line for something that is not a row at all. Put the row down when the drag ends, however it ended.
notes: Found while fixing the-red-dashed-outline-around-the-panel-always-c on 2026-09-07. draggingLayerID and dropTarget are @State on LayersListView (Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift ~1663), set by the row LayerRowView.pickUp and cleared ONLY in LayerRowDropDelegate.performDrop. Any drag that ends without a drop strands them. That fix already stopped a stranded row from hijacking a FILE drag: LayerRowDropDelegate.carriesARow now branches on what is in the air rather than on the flag alone, so a file always gets the file answer. What is left is a text-carrying drag, a colour or a saved colour off the shelf, which is indistinguishable from a row drag on the pasteboard. Two ways out, pick one: (a) move the row-in-the-air state onto EditorState and let the same watch that settles PanelDropMarking put it down when nothing is in the air (PanelDropMarking.idleGrace, NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons), which is the pattern already in EditorState+LayersPanel.startPanelDropWatch; or (b) give a row drag its own carried type instead of a bare NSString, declared in UTExportedTypeDeclarations in Scripts/build-app.sh the way com.photonz.component is, and register the row target for that instead of .text - note ColorDrags warning that an undeclared identifier carries zero bytes, so a bare swift build with no Info.plist needs a fallback.
acceptance: Pick a row up and press escape, and the list is holding nothing afterwards
Pick a row up and let go over the picture, and the list is holding nothing afterwards
Pick a row up and let go outside the window, and the list is holding nothing afterwards
A colour dragged over a layer row right after any of those draws no reorder line
A test covers a row picked up and then abandoned without any drop, written before the change

log.note: Reproduced on the probe (/tmp/stranded-row-walk.json, Scripts/playtest.sh). Control step 13, nothing picked up: colour over the "Rectangle 2" row = 'nothing takes it'. Step 15 picks the "Rectangle" row up and walks away without a word (leave:true, which is what escape and a release outside the window look like). Step 18, the SAME colour over the SAME row = '_PlatformDraggingDestinationView would take it', and the screen capture 4-colour-after-a-stranded-row-sc.png shows a blue reorder line under "Rectangle 2" while a colour is in the air. So the bug is real and visible, not just readable in the source.

Adversarial review of the two ways out named in the notes. Option (b), a private carried type for a row drag, only stops OTHER drags being misread; it never puts the row down, so after escape the list is still holding a row and the next real row drag starts from a lie. It also needs an Info.plist declaration, and a bare swift build has none. Option (a) is both smaller and the actual fix: the state moves next to the mark that already solved this exact problem for files, and the watch that settles that mark settles this too. Shortest version: one small pure value in the core with the same shape as PanelDropMarking, one watch, no new timer.

Built option (a). New pure value LayerRowInHand in PhotonzCore (rowID, landing, and the same idleGrace deadline PanelDropMarking uses), covered by Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/LayerRowInHandTests.swift written before it existed and red for the right reason first. EditorState holds it beside panelDropMarking and the ONE watch, startPanelDropWatch, now settles both. LayersListView and LayerRowDropDelegate lost their @State/@Binding pair and read the editor instead. Note the split: the hand itself is @ObservationIgnored because its deadline is pushed out on every frame of a drag, and the list watches two published values (layerRowInHand, layerRowLanding) that change only when the picture does, so the drag costs the same redraws it used to.

Verified on the probe with Scripts/playtest/row-put-down-walk.json. Three abandonments - over another row, over the picture, in the panel with nothing under it - each end 'the list is holding no row', and the colour carried over a row after each one is answered 'nothing takes it' with no line in the capture. A real reorder still lands and empties the hand. Screen Recording was granted so all of these are real captures. Regression: Scripts/playtest/panel-mark-walk.json still passes, so a file arriving after a row drag still gets the file answer. Full suite 4622 tests green. The harness gained a rowInHand() readout, printed by dragOver and dragRow, because nothing on screen says what the list is holding once the line has gone.
Release: LayersPanel.swift is shared, not forked into Releases/Next, so this reaches Current as well as Next. That is right for a bug of this shape and there is nothing to port.
